name: NMO-LAB
description: NMO-LAB photography: archival prints and digital files.

physical.label: Editions
physical.intro: Archival pigment prints on cotton rag paper, signed and numbered.
physical.intro_zh: 以藝術微噴搭配棉質相紙輸出，每張皆有簽名與編號。

digital.label: Digital Files
digital.intro: High-resolution files delivered by email. Personal use licence only.
digital.intro_zh: 高解析度檔案，以電子郵件寄送，僅限個人使用授權。

about.intro:
台北攝影師，專注於街頭、城市與自然光。每件作品都能以手工裝裱的實體相紙收藏，或下載高解析數位檔。

作品以藝術微噴與棉質相紙輸出，每份附簽名與編號。

也承接少量商業與編輯合作。
about.intro_en:
Taipei-based photographer focused on street, city and natural light. Every work can be collected as a hand-mounted physical print, or downloaded as a high-resolution digital file.

Works are output on archival pigment inks and cotton rag paper, each signed and numbered.

A small number of commercial and editorial commissions are also accepted.

policies.title: Printing & Shipping
policies.text: 每張相紙手工包裝，確認付款後 3 至 5 個工作天內寄出，以硬挺紙筒或平板包裝；可客製尺寸與裝裱，歡迎來信詢問。國際運送的關稅由收件人負擔。數位檔案以電子郵件交付，不需運費。（範例文字，請改成你的實際規則）
policies.text_en: Each print is hand-packed and shipped within 3–5 business days of confirmed payment, in a rigid tube or flat packaging. Custom sizes and framing are available, please enquire by email. Import duties on international shipments are paid by the recipient. Digital files are delivered by email with no shipping fee. policies.title: Returns
policies.text: 商品若於運送中受損，請在收到後 7 天內附照片來信，我們會補寄或退款。數位檔案一旦交付，恕不退款。（範例文字，請依你的實際政策與當地法規調整）
policies.text_en: If an item is damaged in transit, email us photos within 7 days of receipt and we will reship or refund. Digital files are non-refundable once delivered. (Sample text — adjust to your actual policy and local regulations.)
